name: Focus Timer
description: One clock, shared by everyone in the space. Turn the dial like a kitchen timer to set the length, press the middle to start, and the ring drains for everybody at once — a study room, a work sprint, a twenty-minute tidy that the whole house can see counting down. Whoever started it and what it is for are written under the dial. Space editors drive the timer; everyone else, including anyone the timer is shared with publicly, watches the same countdown live. There is no clock running on a server: the host stores the moment the session ends and every device works out the rest for itself, so the numbers agree even if a device sleeps.
